Title: App starts for Mines Entry site
Pre-Condition: Site settings file is ready and app is installed
Expected Result: App opens without error and shows Mines Entry ready

Title: Real equipment mode works
Pre-Condition: Demo mode is off and controller is connected
Expected Result: App connects to lights boom and sensor (not demo)

Title: Demo mode works without hardware
Expected Result: App runs using simulated lights and sensor

Title: Home / status screen opens
Expected Result: Operator screen loads and shows Ready

Title: Reset returns to Ready
Pre-Condition: App is in any mid-process state
Expected Result: After reset: red light on boom closed Ready again

Title: Valid tag starts the process
Pre-Condition: Gate is Ready and cloud is available
Expected Result: Tag is accepted and truck check starts

Title: Empty or bad tag is rejected
Expected Result: Error shown process does not start

Title: Second tag ignored while busy
Expected Result: Second tag is ignored first process continues

Title: Valid mobile tag works like reader
Expected Result: Cloud reply returned and process continues

Title: Invalid mobile tag shows error
Pre-Condition: Gate is Ready cloud rejects tag
Expected Result: Error on display then back to Ready

Title: Valid tag accepted by cloud
Expected Result: Truck number shown process continues to plate check

Title: Invalid tag rejected by cloud
Expected Result: Error shown boom stays closed then Ready

Title: Plate match allows entry
Pre-Condition: Tag already validated plate check on
Expected Result: Plate matches boom opens green light Entry Granted

Title: Plate mismatch waits for office
Pre-Condition: Tag validated plate does not match
Expected Result: Error shown system waits for office approval

Title: Plate unreadable waits for office
Expected Result: Error shown system waits for office approval

Title: Plate check off still needs office approval
Expected Result: No camera call truck info sent then office approval required before boom opens

Title: Camera / plate service down
Expected Result: Error shown boom does not open returns to Ready

Title: Office says wait keep checking
Expected Result: System keeps checking does not open boom yet

Title: Office approves then entry allowed
Expected Result: Boom opens green light Entry Granted

Title: Office rejects returns to Ready
Expected Result: Boom stays closed red light Ready

Title: Cloud allows boom then boom opens
Expected Result: Boom opens and green light on

Title: Cloud boom permission fails boom stays closed
Pre-Condition: Plate match but cloud boom call fails
Expected Result: Boom does not open safe closed state

Title: After entry truck on then off clears gate
Pre-Condition: Boom open green light waiting for truck to pass
Expected Result: After truck leaves: boom closes red light Ready

Title: Truck only arriving does not close boom yet
Expected Result: Boom stays open until truck has left

Title: If truck never leaves gate auto-resets
Pre-Condition: Boom open and timeout time reached
Expected Result: After timeout Ready again boom closed red light

Title: Ready state is red and boom down
Expected Result: Red light on green off boom closed

Title: Entry allowed is green and boom up
Expected Result: Green light on red off boom open

Title: Sensor read works (read mode)
Expected Result: Entry sensor reading works

Title: Coil write mode FC5 works for lights and boom
Pre-Condition: Write mode set to FC5 real controller
Expected Result: Red green boom open close respond correctly

Title: Register write mode FC6 works for lights and boom
Pre-Condition: Write mode set to FC6 real controller
Expected Result: Same lights and boom behaviour as coil mode

Title: Error text shown for bad tag
Expected Result: Display shows tag error

Title: Truck number shown after valid tag
Expected Result: Display shows truck number

Title: Entry Granted shown
Expected Result: Display shows truck Entry Granted

Title: Happy path tag to Ready again
Expected Result: Tag → plate OK → boom open → truck passes → Ready boom closed

Title: Mismatch then office approve then Ready
Expected Result: Tag → plate fail → office OK → boom open → truck passes → Ready

Title: Plate check off then office approve then Ready
Expected Result: Tag → office approval → boom open → truck passes → Ready

Title: Operator login required for free pass / reset actions
Expected Result: Restricted actions stay blocked until login

Title: Installed app opens dashboard
Expected Result: Dashboard opens without missing screen error
